source.author: verg
source.text: Portus ab Euroo fluctu curvatus in arcum, obiectae salsa spumant aspargine cautes; ipse latet; gemino demittunt bracchia muro turriti scopuli, refugitque ab litore templum.
source.text_original: Portus ab Euroo fluctu curvatus in arcum, / obiectae salsa spumant aspargine cautes; / ipse latet; gemino demittunt bracchia muro / turriti scopuli, refugitque ab litore templum.
source.text_english: A harbor curved into an arc by the east wind’s wave; the rocks set in the way foam with briny spray; it lies hidden itself. Twin towered cliffs lower their arms in a double wall, and the temple draws back from the shore.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: aequore Trinacrio refugique a parte Pelori stat rupes horrenda fretis: quot in aethera surgit molibus, infernas totidem demissa sub undas.
reuse.text_original: aequore Trinacrio refugique a parte Pelori / stat rupes horrenda fretis: quot in aethera surgit / molibus, infernas totidem demissa sub undas.
reuse.text_english: On the Trinacrian sea and on the side of retreating Pelorus there stands a terrifying rock amid the straits: as many masses as it rises into the air, so many it plunges down beneath the lower waves.
